evidence_quotes.agenda: 'let me explain what this call will look like... I just need a few details about the move and from there I'll be able to tell you what the hourly rate will look like' — framing present, dedicated agenda question never asked.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: 'I want to tell you that I don't drive so you have...' — the rep proactively reassured with specifics ('we're gonna move everything for you, disassemble and reassemble, wrap in blankets... we have our own truck, no need for you to drive'), a real concern handled well.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'this is just an estimate... we only factored in a little extra time' + 'if the move goes faster... you pay less, but if items are more... possibility you pay more' — no rate-lock line, no self-prep tip, no 'does that feel fair' ask.

top_strength: Immediately and specifically addressed the customer's worry about not being able to drive/help, which put her at ease early in the call.
coaching_note: The customer stated upfront she only wanted a quote and wasn't booking today, so no close was attempted — reasonable restraint, but worth a soft rate-lock mention ('your rate locks in once you book') to plant urgency for the follow-up call.
